articles.title: 8th Pay Commission not required to brief Centre during deliberations, Finance Ministry tells Rajya Sabha
articles.summary: The Finance Ministry has clarified in Parliament that the 8th Pay Commission is not required to share regular progress updates with the Centre. The Commission has autonomy, may determine its own procedures under the ToR, and will submit its final recommendations after 18 months, the minister said.

articles.title: Why child-free couples may need more—not less—for retirement
articles.summary: Conventional wisdom says child-free couples need a smaller retirement corpus. In reality, longer retirements, caregiving costs and the absence of a family safety net can make financial planning more demanding.

articles.title: Can you change the income tax regime while filing ITR? Here's what taxpayers should know
articles.summary: Salaried taxpayers can switch between the old and new tax regimes while filing their ITR, regardless of the regime used by their employer for TDS. However, rules differ for those with business income. Understanding the flexibility and tax impact can help taxpayers make an informed choice.

articles.title: EPF Scheme 2026: Got married? Your past PF nomination is now invalid — key FAQs answered
articles.summary: Your earlier EPF nomination becomes invalid once you get married. Filing a fresh nomination ensures your PF benefits are paid to the intended beneficiaries without unnecessary delays or legal complications.

articles.title: Multi-asset allocation funds lead hybrid category inflows: Why investors are rushing in and what to check
articles.summary: Multi-asset allocation funds topped the hybrid category, recording ₹70,819 crore in net inflows in 12 months. These funds help diversify across equities, debt, gold, and other assets. Investors should evaluate allocation strategy, diversification, and capture ratios before investing.

articles.title: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: ₹2,500 monthly assistance announced; Check eligibility, rules and documents
articles.summary: The Delhi government has launched the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', providing eligible women with monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500, of which ₹1,500 will go into a locked savings account. The initiative aims to empower women financially and support family stability.

articles.title: Switched jobs and lost track of your old PF account? Govt explains how EPFO's e-portal can help
articles.summary: The government has revealed that the EPFO has developed an Aadhaar-based e-portal to help members trace old inoperative PF accounts, transfer balances to their active UAN or settle claims. The portal aims to reduce paperwork, improve transparency and simplify access to forgotten PF savings.

articles.title: Delhi HC orders Paytm Payments Bank to be wound up: What happens to your Paytm wallet, UPI now?

articles.title: New vs old regime: Income tax slab rates for FY26 — know how slab-wise tax calculation works
articles.summary: Taxpayers should compare the new and old tax regimes before filing their ITR for FY26. Since India follows a slab-based tax system, only the portion of income falling within each tax slab is taxed at the applicable rate. Understanding this helps taxpayers estimate tax liability more accurately.

articles.title: No Form 16 yet? 31 July ITR deadline is near—here's how salaried taxpayers can still file their income tax return
articles.summary: Form 16 makes return filing easier, but it is not the only document required. By reconciling salary records with Form 26AS, AIS, bank statements and investment proofs, salaried taxpayers can accurately file their returns even without Form 16.
